title: 第一卷 第6章 说出真相
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶笙歌脚步沉重地回到景阳宫，脑子里还回荡着丽妃的话，以及她最后那意味深长的眼神。

还没等他踏进自己那间小耳房，管事太监冯安就阴着脸，堵在了回廊下。

“哟，叶公公，这是打哪儿回来啊？储秀宫的景致，可比咱们景阳宫好看？”冯安声音不高，细长的眼睛里却透着冷光。

叶笙歌心下一沉，知道瞒不过，索性躬身答道：“回冯公公，奴才方才被储秀宫的李公公请去，为丽妃娘娘请了平安脉。”

“请脉？”冯安嗤笑一声，逼近一步，声音压得更低，带着怒意，“小叶子，咱家昨日刚跟你说过什么？这宫里，最忌首鼠两端！”

“你倒好，转头就攀上储秀宫的高枝儿了？婉贵妃娘娘待你不薄，你就是这么报答的？吃里扒外的东西！”

“冯公公明鉴，”叶笙歌维持着躬身的姿势，声音平稳，“丽妃娘娘传召，奴才不敢不去。”

“诊治之时，丽妃娘娘确有招揽之意，但奴才已婉言回绝。奴才既在景阳宫当差，心里便只有婉贵妃娘娘一位主子。”

“回绝？说得好听！”冯安显然不信，“你前脚刚救下娘娘，后脚就去给丽妃看病，你让旁人怎么看？让娘娘心里怎么想？来人——”

他正要喊人，一道清柔急促的女声插了进来：“冯公公，且慢。”

兰心快步走来：“冯公公息怒。娘娘已经知晓此事，传叶公公即刻过去问话。如何处置，自有娘娘定夺。”

冯安到嘴边的话噎住了，脸色变了几变，终究不敢违逆贵妃，只能狠狠瞪了叶笙歌一眼，从牙缝里挤出一句：“……既然是娘娘传唤，还不快滚过去！仔细你的皮！”

“是。”叶笙歌应了声，跟着兰心往正殿走去。

路上，兰心步履匆匆，并未看他，只低声快速说了一句：“丽妃娘娘当年小产，据说是用了咱们娘娘送去的一碟点心，之后便落了病根，再难有孕。”

“娘娘并不知情，其中恐有蹊跷，但丽妃认定是娘娘所为，自此结下死仇。”

“你今日去储秀宫，无论丽妃说了什么，娘娘问起，你需得想清楚再答。”

叶笙歌默默点头。原来还有这般旧怨。丽妃的恨意，倒是有了更具体的缘由。

正殿内，苏清婉已起身，靠坐在窗边的软榻上，手里拿着一卷书，却并未在看。

她换了一身月白色常服，未施粉黛，脸色仍有些苍白，更显得眉眼清冷。

听到脚步声，她抬眼望来，目光平静，却让叶笙歌感到一股无形的压力。

Page (1/3)

Ye Shengge returned to Jingyang Palace with heavy steps, Concubine Li's words and her last meaningful look echoing in his mind.

Before he could step into his small wing, the eunuch in charge, Feng An, blocked him under the corridor with a sullen face.

"Hey, Eunuch Ye, where did you come from? The scenery of Chuxiu Palace is better than our Jingyang Palace?" Feng An's voice was low, but there was a cold light in his slender eyes.

Ye Shengge's heart sank, knowing that he couldn't hide it, he simply bowed and replied: "Back to Eunuch Feng, I was just invited by Eunuch Li from Chuxiu Palace to get Ping'an Pulse for Concubine Li."

"Please take a pulse?" Feng An sneered, took a step closer, and lowered his voice with anger, "Little Ye Zi, what did our family just tell you yesterday? In this palace, the most taboo thing is to have a head and a rat!"

"Why don't you turn around and climb up the high branches of Chuxiu Palace? Concubine Wan Guifei treats you well, and this is how you repay her? You eat everything inside and outside!"

"Eunuch Feng Mingjian," Ye Shengge maintained his bowing posture and said in a steady voice, "I dare not not go when Concubine Li summons me."

"During the diagnosis and treatment, Concubine Li really wanted to recruit her, but I politely declined. Since I am working as an errand in Jingyang Palace, I only have Concubine Wan as my master in my heart."

"Refuse? That's nice to say!" Feng An obviously didn't believe it, "You just saved the empress, and then you went to treat Li Fei. How do you want others to think? What do you want the empress to think? Someone -"

Just as he was about to call someone, a soft and urgent female voice interrupted: "Eunuch Feng, wait a minute."

Lan Xin walked over quickly: "Eunuch Feng, please calm down. Your Majesty already knows about this matter, and it is said that Eunuch Ye will go over immediately to ask questions. How to deal with it is up to your Majesty."

Feng An choked on his words, and his face changed several times. After all, he did not dare to disobey the imperial concubine. He could only glare at Ye Shengge fiercely, and said through his teeth: "...Since it is the empress who has summoned me, get out of here! Watch your skin carefully!"

"Yes." Ye Shengge responded and followed Lan Xin to the main hall.

On the way, Lan Xin walked in a hurry and did not look at him. She only whispered quickly: "Empress Li Fei had a miscarriage back then. It is said that she ate a plate of snacks sent by our empress. After that, the root cause of the disease fell into place, and it is difficult to get pregnant again."

"The empress didn't know about it, so there might be something fishy involved, but Concubine Li believed that it was the empress who did it, and they started to have a deadly feud from then on."

"When you go to Chuxiu Palace today, no matter what Concubine Li said, if the empress asks you, you must think it over carefully before answering."

Ye Shengge nodded silently.It turns out there are still such old grievances.Concubine Li's hatred had a more specific reason.

In the main hall, Su Qingwan had stood up and was sitting on the soft couch by the window. She was holding a book in her hand, but she was not reading it.

She changed into moon-white normal clothes, without any makeup, her face was still a little pale, and her eyebrows looked even colder.

Hearing the footsteps, she looked up, her eyes calm, but Ye Shengge felt an invisible pressure.
